subject.title: fix(browser): tab creation steals window focus during agent automation

question: Should the extension relay intentionally treat an omitted Target.createTarget background/focus pair as OpenClaw background automation, even though Chrome's generic CDP contract treats the same request as foreground?
rationale: The code correctly implements either policy, but deciding whether the relay is a strict CDP compatibility surface or an OpenClaw automation surface affects existing clients and cannot be resolved mechanically.

options.title: Approve background automation default
options.body: Accept the relay-specific divergence, document it as intentional, and retain the explicit-parameter compatibility tests.

options.title: Preserve generic CDP semantics
options.body: Keep omitted requests foreground-compatible and add a narrower explicit signal for OpenClaw and Playwright automation.

options.title: Pause the relay half
options.body: Land only the direct-CDP change and hold extension-relay behavior until a durable caller-specific mechanism is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve background automation default
recommendation.body: Accept the relay-specific divergence, document it as intentional, and retain the explicit-parameter compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the adjacent CDP focus contract and have the strongest available recent browser behavior history.
